evals.description: Founder testing a meal prep service idea through the full Foundation Sprint
evals.prompt: I want to run a Click Foundation Sprint for a meal prep app called QuickPlate targeting busy parents.
assertions: The coach asks one question at a time and addresses the user as the sole Decider
Step 1 enforces plain language customer definition without demographic personas
Step 1 rejects feature statements (e.g. 'needs a recipe app') and insists on real problems
Step 1 explicitly inquires about the 800-pound gorilla and includes 'do nothing' as competitor
Step 2 produces a 2x2 matrix and 3 practical principles (differentiate, reinforce, safeguard)
Step 3 uses Note-and-Vote to brainstorm approaches and evaluates them through magic lenses
Step 4 produces a Founding Hypothesis strictly matching: 'If we help [customer] solve [problem] with [approach], they will choose it over [competitors] because our solution is [differentiation]'
Step 4 produces a Scorecard with 6 questions rated with yes/maybe/not_yet/no
The coach invokes scripts/click_coach.py to persist state after major decisions

evals.description: Founder resuming an existing sprint from local state
evals.prompt: Let's continue our Click Foundation Sprint. We already finished the basics and differentiation.
assertions: The coach inspects existing state before asking questions
The coach summarizes previously completed decisions (customer, problem, 2x2 differentiators, principles)
The coach resumes at Step 3 (Approach Brainstorming) without restarting from Step 1
The coach does not overwrite existing data files
